meta.title: Exactly the open quantity plus the over-quantity tolerance is accepted
gaps: The vocabulary has no setup recipe or operation for a purchase-request line with an open quantity and over_quantity_tolerance_percentage.
The vocabulary has no operation for pulling a line into a draft or creating a second draft with quantities 110 and 110.01.
The required HTTP 422 response with code 557 is not among the documented known error codes.
